import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]
    N = int(lines[0])
    categories = []
    for i in range(1, N+1):
        parts = lines[i].split()
        name = parts[0]
        W = int(parts[1])
        words = parts[2:2+W]
        categories.append((name, words))

    statement_words = []
    for line in lines[N+1:]:
        statement_words.extend(line.split())

    category_matches = defaultdict(int)
    for name, words in categories:
        for word in words:
            category_matches[name] += statement_words.count(word)

    if not category_matches:
        return

    max_matches = max(category_matches.values())
    suggested_categories = [name for name, count in category_matches.items() if count == max_matches]
    suggested_categories.sort()

    for category in suggested_categories:
        print(category)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
